title: Derived composition preserves the specified adjunction normalization
statement:
Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B,\mathcal C$ be Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], with ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $L_a:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$, $L_b:\mathcal B\to\mathcal C$, and $L_c:\mathcal A\to\mathcal C$ be exact additive functors, with specified additive right adjoints $R_a,R_b,R_c$. Fix a natural isomorphism $\lambda:L_bL_a\xrightarrow{\sim}L_c$, and let $\kappa:R_c\xrightarrow{\sim}R_aR_b$ be its conjugate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] under $L_c\dashv R_c$ and the composite adjunction $L_bL_a\dashv R_aR_b$ [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. For an additive functor $H$ write $C(H)$ for termwise application to complexes, and write $D(H)$ for its descent when $H$ is exact. A complex $I$ is K-injective if every chain map from an acyclic complex to $I$ is null-homotopic. Compute total right derived functors $\mathbf R R_i$ on K-injective resolutions [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], and use the adjunctions $D(L_i)\dashv\mathbf R R_i$ induced by the specified underived adjunctions: the canonical derived adjunctions of [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors], where $D(L_i)$ is the left derived functor of the exact functor $L_i$.

There is a natural isomorphism $\kappa^D:\mathbf R R_c\xrightarrow{\sim}(\mathbf R R_a)(\mathbf R R_b)$ with the following normalization: at a K-injective $I$ of $\mathcal C$, it is the class of $C(\kappa)_I:C(R_c)I\to C(R_a)C(R_b)I$ under the canonical resolution identifications (in particular $C(R_b)I$ is K-injective). This $\kappa^D$ is precisely the conjugate of $D(\lambda):D(L_b)D(L_a)\xrightarrow{\sim}D(L_c)$ under the derived adjunction for $c$ and the composite of the derived adjunctions for $a,b$. Thus after these comparisons the unit and counit are exactly the composite unit and counit, not arbitrary adjunction structures on isomorphic functors.

Apply rightDerived_ext to the composite right-derived unit. Expand conjugation [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate]. Naturality moves the derived unit past the comparison. The derived unit and counit factorization equations of [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived] reduce the result to the ordinary homotopy adjunction. Its unit and counit are termwise by [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy]. Expand the composite counit [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction] and the ordinary conjugate equation; the homological-complex quotient maps this identity to the required localized identity. This is the source CompConjugate proof with independent Hom universes, rather than a new mathematical lemma.

The descended left comparison is definitionally the inverse of derivedCompositionLeftIso, so equality of the resulting isomorphisms identifies the inverse of rightDerivedFunctorCompIso' Rb Ra kappa.symm with kappaD.hom.
